name: Stevenage November 2026
information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

**Dual Rounds**
This competition will use Dual Rounds for 3x3 Blindfolded (see [regulation 9v](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9v)). Everyone will be able to compete in both rounds, for up to 10 attempts total across the two.
